English: Summons Arbalist minions which use projectile attacks.
简体中文: 召唤发射投射物的劲弩。

English: Summons Living Lightning Minions, which target nearby enemies with a number of Melee Chaining Attacks before dissipating. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
简体中文: 召唤活体闪电仆从，向附近敌人发动数次连锁攻击后消散。敌人将不会直接攻击这些召唤生物，且可穿过它们。

English: Summons a Ballista Totem which uses this Skill
简体中文: 召唤一个使用该技能的弩炮图腾

English: Summons a Bestial Rhoa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Rhoa uses a charge and has an aura that intimidates enemies. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个兽化恐喙鸟。兽化恐喙鸟能进行近战攻击并拥有冲锋技能，而且附带能威吓敌人的光环。兽化恐喙鸟的攻击无法被闪避。敌人将不会直接攻击该召唤生物，并且它们对伤害免疫。

English: Summons a Bestial Snake. The Bestial Snake fires powerful chaos projectile attacks. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个兽化巨蛇。兽化巨蛇的攻击能射出强大的混沌投射物。敌人将不会直接攻击该召唤生物，并且它们对伤害免疫。

English: Summons a Bestial Ursa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Ursa uses a powerful Ground Slam and Rallying Cry. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个兽化之爪。兽化之爪能进行近战攻击并拥有裂地之击技能，而且附带激励战吼。敌人将不会直接攻击该召唤生物，并且它们对伤害免疫。

English: Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.
简体中文: 召唤一个腐化魔像，给非魔像召唤生物附加物理伤害。这种魔像可以挥出伤害递增，速度越来越快的破空斩，还可以发出骸骨突刺。并使它附近每个非魔像召唤生物造成更多伤害。

English: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes.
简体中文: 召唤一个腐化魔像。腐化魔像可以挥出伤害递增，速度越来越快的破空斩，还可以发出骸骨突刺。

English: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.
简体中文: 召唤一个腐化魔像。腐化魔像可以挥出伤害递增，速度越来越快的破空斩，可以消耗灵柩来治疗自己，并获得发出毁灭性骸骨突刺的能力。附近每个非魔像召唤生物可以使它造成更多伤害。

English: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you damage over time and chaos resistance. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个混沌魔像，启动时使你获得持续伤害和混沌抗性。除了一般的近战攻击外，混沌魔像会施放一个造成持续伤害的混沌光环和混沌之刺。

English: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个混沌魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，混沌魔像会施放一个造成持续伤害的混沌光环和混沌之刺。

English: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个混沌魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，混沌魔像会施放一个造成高额持续伤害并施加死亡凋零的混沌光环。

English: Summons a Flame Golem that grants you increased Damage and Area of Effect. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.
简体中文: 召唤一个烈焰魔像，启动时会提高你的伤害和效果区域。烈焰魔像会施放火焰放射，火焰波浪，还会射出会爆炸的弧状移动投射物。

English: Summons a Flame Golem. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.
简体中文: 召唤一个烈焰魔像。烈焰魔像会施放火焰放射，火焰波浪，还会射出会爆炸的弧状移动投射物。

English: Summons a Flame Golem. When summoned, the Flame Golem attacks by falling from the sky, dealing fire damage in an area and leaving burning ground around the impact. After landing, it can cast a fire spray and a wave of fire damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个烈焰魔像。烈焰魔像被召唤时从天而降，撞击时造成范围伤害并留下燃烧地面。落地后会施放火焰放射和火焰波浪。

English: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.
简体中文: 召唤一个闪电魔像，给予你额外的攻击、施法速度和魔力再生。魔像会对敌人进行雷击，召唤会电击敌人的闪电球，并施放一个为魔像及其周围友军的法术和攻击附加闪电伤害的临时光环。

English: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.
简体中文: 召唤一个闪电魔像。魔像会射出投射物法术，召唤会电击敌人的闪电球，并施放一个为魔像及其周围友军的法术和攻击附加闪电伤害的临时光环。

English: Summons a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个幻灵，它会使用造成物理伤害的穿透投射物法术。

English: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.
简体中文: 召唤一个追命死灵，它会施放多种区域攻击。追命死灵会削弱你的其它非追命死灵的召唤生物，还会消耗它们以治疗并暂时强化自己。

English: Summons a Relic of a random element that stays near you. Depending on the element chosen, the relic minion will have an Anger, Hatred, or Wrath aura. These relics explode when they die, dealing elemental damage to enemies around them. If you already have a relic of the chosen element, its duration will be refreshed instead of summoning a new one.
简体中文: 在你身旁召唤一个随机元素的遗物。根据选择的元素，遗物召唤生物会具有愤怒、憎恨或雷霆光环。遗物被击败时爆炸，对周围的敌人造成元素伤害。如果你已拥有该元素的遗物，则会刷新它的持续时间，而非召唤一个新的遗物。

English: Summons a Sentinel of Radiance which follows you and attacks enemies in melee, while burning enemies around it and taking a portion of damage from hits for you. You can only have one Sentinel of Radiance.
简体中文: 召唤一个跟随你的光辉哨兵，它会攻击近战范围内的敌人，使周围的敌人燃烧，并替你承受一定比例的击中伤害。你只能拥有一个光辉哨兵。

English: Summons a Spectral Tiger Companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each Spectral Tiger grants you a buff that increases Critical Strike Chance, and increases Attack and Cast Speed. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.
简体中文: 召唤一头幽虎同伴攻击周围的敌人，持续一段时间后消失。每头幽虎都会给你提供增益效果，可以增加暴击几率，并提升攻击和施法速度。达到召唤上限时使用会刷新其中一头幽虎的生命和持续时间。

English: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration and defences. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个为你提供额外生命回复和防御的巨石魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的冲击波来嘲讽附近的敌人。

English: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个巨石魔像，你受到敌人击中物理伤害的一定比例由其生命承担。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的猛击来嘲讽附近的敌人。

English: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个巨石魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的猛击来嘲讽附近的敌人。

English: Summons a Taunting Contraption that taunts nearby enemies to attack it.
简体中文: 召唤一个嘲讽装置，嘲讽周围的敌人。

English: Summons a Totem which uses this Skill
简体中文: 召唤一个使用该技能的图腾

English: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.
简体中文: 召唤一个发射分叉箭矢的弩炮图腾。

English: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with piercing arrows. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个发射穿刺箭矢的弩炮图腾。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，消耗钢刃碎片以发射多重箭矢，在巨力作用下分裂成散弹。敌人可以同时被多重箭矢击中。需要弓类武器。钢刃碎片由【钢铁呼唤】提供。

English: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，发射多重箭矢，在巨力作用下分裂成散弹。敌人可以同时被多重箭矢击中。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射多支箭矢，每支以一个敌人为目标。箭矢落地时对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射一连串箭矢。这些箭矢以一条直线击中地面，每一支都对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射一连串箭矢。这些箭矢沿两条垂直线条击中地面，每一支都对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a horde of Hiveborn Breach monsters to do your bidding. These summoned monsters have all their physical damage converted to cold.
简体中文: 召唤一支裂隙虫群怪物大军为你作战。这些被召唤的怪物会将其全部物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。

English: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
简体中文: 召唤一个强力的追命死灵，它会被动地跟随你，不会攻击敌人。追命死灵会削弱你的其它召唤生物，还会消耗它们以治疗并暂时强化自己。召唤追命死灵后再施放该技能可以让它冲向目标地点施放一次强力攻击。不能被触发或受“施法回响”和“释出”辅助，不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用。

English: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个强力的追命死灵，它会施放凌厉的区域攻击。追命死灵会削弱你的其它召唤生物，偶尔还会消耗它们来强化自己，并给自己回血。召唤追命死灵后再施放该技能可以让它冲向目标地点施放一次强力攻击。

English: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow.
简体中文: 在目标地点周围召唤一圈弩炮图腾。这些弩炮会向目标地点射击一次后消失。需要弓类武器。

English: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
简体中文: 召唤只能存在极短时间的愤怒狂灵，这些火焰魔侍将会冲至敌人身边并快速的进行攻击，并将其造成的所有物理伤害转化为火焰伤害。敌方生物将不会主动攻击这些狂灵，并可以穿越它们。

English: Summons a spectral wolf companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each spectral wolf grants you a buff that adds damage to your attacks. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.
简体中文: 召唤一头幽狼伙伴攻击周围的敌人，持续一段时间后消失。每头幽狼都会给你提供增加攻击伤害的增益效果。达到召唤上限时使用会刷新其中一头的生命和持续时间。

English: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾, 它会吞噬附近的灵柩并为你回复生命.

English: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾, 它会与你和你所操控的所有图腾之间产生火焰连接, 经过火焰连接或是靠近火焰连接尾端的敌人将会受到燃烧伤害.

English: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，向你和你操控的其他图腾发射一道火焰光束，使被光束击中的敌人受到燃烧伤害。光束两端附近的敌人也会受到燃烧伤害。达到最大激活图腾数量时，该技能召唤的所有图腾将引爆，并在一段时间内对敌人施加相同的燃烧伤害。

English: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续对附近的敌人喷射火焰，并在图腾周围创造一片奉献地面。

English: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies.
简体中文: 召唤一个带有光环的图腾，为你和周围的友军提供生命再生。

English: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies. When things affected by the aura are hit, the totem's life is removed instead for some of the damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个带有光环的图腾，为你和周围的友军提供生命再生。受光环影响的对象被击中时，图腾会损失生命来承担部分伤害。

English: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾, 它会持续的震动附近的地面, 击退附近的敌人并造成伤害.

English: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续震动附近的地面，对敌人造成伤害。

English: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.
简体中文: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续的嘲讽周围的敌人对其进行攻击.

English: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个寒冰魔像，启动时会提高你的暴击和命中。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。

English: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.
简体中文: 召唤一个寒冰魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。

English: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle.
简体中文: 召唤一个寒冰魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。它会在低血时触发一个自毁法术，造成范围伤害并发射环形的冰霜投射物。

English: Summons an army of skeletal soldiers, archers and mages, led by a powerful general.
简体中文: 召唤一支由强大的魔侍将军所统率，由魔侍兵，魔侍弓箭手与魔侍法师所组成的魔侍大军。

English: Summons an effigy of Doedre, which will project auras of all the curse skill gems socketed in Doedre's Skin. These curses have less effectiveness.
简体中文: 召唤一个德瑞的雕像，该雕像会在一个范围内投射插在德瑞之肤上的所有诅咒技能。这些诅咒的效能较弱。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.
简体中文: 召唤一个不朽的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放两个下列增益法术：秘术增强，加快施法速度并提高魔力再生率，以及一个有几率导致感电并穿透闪电抗性的增益效果。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: 1 additional Projectile, +1 Chain, Pierce 1 additional Target, or Projectiles Fork.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会对你施放随机增益，附加以下任意一个或全部效果：发射 1 个额外投射物，连锁 +1，投射物穿透 1 个额外目标，或者投射物分裂时额外分裂一次。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: Fire 2 additional Projectiles, Chain 2 additional times, Projectiles Pierce 2 additional targets, or Projectiles Fork then Fork an additional time.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会对你施放随机增益，附加以下任意一个或全部效果：发射 2 个额外投射物，额外连锁 2 次，投射物穿透 2 个额外目标，或者投射物分裂时额外分裂一次。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的冰雷先驱者. 先驱者偶尔会冰缓或感电敌人并连锁到附近的敌人.

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock with increased effect to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对敌人施加提高效果的冰缓或感电效果，并连锁给周围其它敌人。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally cast Arcane Surge on you, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration.
简体中文: 召唤一个不朽的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放秘术增强，提高施法速度和魔力再生率。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放光环，增加你和你周围所有队友的行动速度。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you, and all allies and enemies near you.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放光环，增加你和你周围所有敌我单位的行动速度。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, and reducing the Damage you take.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。当你周围有稀有或传奇敌人时，它会偶尔给你提供一个增益效果，大幅提高伤害、攻击速度和移动速度，并降低你受到的伤害。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, reducing the Damage you take, and causing Bleeding Enemies that you Kill to Explode, dealing 10% of their maximum Life as Physical Damage.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。当你周围有稀有或传奇敌人时，它会偶尔给你提供一个增益效果，大幅提高伤害、攻击速度和移动速度，降低你受到的伤害。并使被你击败的敌人爆炸，造成其生命上限 10% 的物理伤害。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, and makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的不屈先驱者。在你持续吟唱时, 先驱者偶尔会对你施放一个增益, 减少你受到的伤害, 使你免疫所有晕眩和元素异常状态。

English: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会在你持续吟唱时偶尔会对你施放一个增益效果，减少你受到的伤害，使你避免所有晕眩和元素异常状态，并免受诅咒影响。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Arohongui tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes travel skills recover cooldowns faster. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的亚欧红古部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，提升旅行技能的冷却回复速度。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Hinekora tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates mana. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的辛格拉部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使你获得魔力再生。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Kitava tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes a percentage of your leech recover instantly. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的奇塔弗部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使一定比例的生命偷取立即生效。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ngamahu tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which allows totems to take some damage from hits for you. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的努葛玛呼部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，让图腾替你承受部分击中伤害。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ramako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents additional damage from suppressed spells. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的雷默科部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，压制法术时能阻挡更多伤害。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Rongokurai tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which lets a percentage of your armour protect against all damage types. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的隆戈库莱部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，让你的部分护甲值能够抵御所有伤害类型。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tasalio tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents your action speed being lowered. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的塔萨里奥部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使你的行动速度无法被降低。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tawhoa tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which refills flasks. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.
简体中文: 召唤一个不死的塔赫亚部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，补充你的药剂。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。

English: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tukohama tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates rage. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

English: Supports any skill that can kill enemies.
简体中文: 辅助任意能击败敌人的技能。

English: Supports any skill that deals damage or has a duration.
简体中文: 辅助任意能造成伤害或有持续时间的技能。

English: Supports any skill that deals damage.
简体中文: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能。

English: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.
简体中文: 辅助任意有持续时间或能通过击中造成异常状态的技能。

English: Supports any skill that has a duration.
简体中文: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments
简体中文: 辅助任意可以击中敌人或施加异常状态的技能

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech energy shield based on damage dealt.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取能量护盾。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech life based on damage dealt.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取生命。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making it easier to stun enemies with those skills.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使被辅助技能更容易眩晕敌人。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的冰霜抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的元素抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的火焰抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的闪电抗性。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，或能直接造成燃烧伤害的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or could otherwise apply elemental ailments.
简体中文: 辅助任意能击中敌人或对敌人造成元素异常状态的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies.
简体中文: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If enemies are left below 10% of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，如果敌人在被击中后低于 10% 生命上限值则会被立即击败。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If normal or magic enemies are left below a percentage of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.
简体中文: 辅助任何能击中敌人的技能。若普通或魔法怪物被这些技能击中后，其剩余生命值低于一定百分比，则会被直接斩杀。

English: Supports any skill that hits enemies. Minions cannot gain Cruelty.
简体中文: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能。召唤生物无法获得凌厉。

English: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.
简体中文: 辅助能击中或燃烧敌人的技能，以及能施加元素异常状态的技能。

English: Supports any skill with a duration.
简体中文: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能。

English: Supports any skill with an area of effect, regardless of whether that skill deals damage.
简体中文: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能，不论该技能是否造成伤害。

English: Supports any skill with an area of effect.
简体中文: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能。

English: Supports any skill you use to hit enemies yourself. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助任意你用来击中敌人的技能。无法辅助图腾，陷阱和地雷所施放的技能。

English: Supports any skill. Minions, Totems, Traps and Mines cannot gain Inspiration Charges.
简体中文: 辅助任意技能。召唤生物、图腾、陷阱、地雷无法获得启迪球。

English: Supports attack skills that aren't triggered.
简体中文: 辅助并非被触发施放的攻击技能。

English: Supports attack skills that can be used with Wands. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助法杖可以使用的攻击技能。无法辅助瓦尔技能，召唤生物技能，位移技能或图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports attack skills that can be used with bows. Supported skills can only be used with bows. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助弓类可以使用的攻击技能。被辅助的技能只能用弓才能生效。无法辅助瓦尔技能，召唤生物技能，位移技能或图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports attack skills that fire projectiles, making the increase to physical melee damage from strength also increase their physical projectile damage.
简体中文: 辅助发射投射物的攻击技能，使力量属性也会像提高近战物理伤害一样提高投射物物理伤害。

English: Supports attack skills that hit enemies, causing those hits to leech mana based on damage dealt.
简体中文: 辅助击中敌人的攻击技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取魔力。

English: Supports attack skills that use bows or wands and fire projectiles ahead. Instead of using that skill, you will throw mines that will use the skill for you when you detonate them, targeting your location. Mines cannot use channelling skills.
简体中文: 辅助使用弓类或法杖发射投射物的攻击技能。你不再使用被辅助的技能，而是投掷地雷。引爆地雷时，地雷会对你所在的位置使用该技能。地雷无法使用吟唱技能。

English: Supports attack skills, or other skills that can maim enemies.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能，或其它能使敌人瘫痪的技能。

English: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.
简体中文: 辅助能造成伤害的攻击或法术技能。

English: Supports attack skills, providing a bonus to all damage dealt by those skills while your life is full.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能，当你满血时该技能造成的所有伤害提高。

English: Supports attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports attack skills. Cannot support triggered skills, skills which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps or mines.
简体中文: 辅助攻击技能。无法辅助触发技能、召唤生物技能，以及图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports attacks, causing them to trigger the Prismatic Burst spell. Cannot support triggered attacks or attacks used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助攻击，使其触发棱光魔爆法术。不能辅助触发攻击技能或除你之外的生物使用的攻击技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助影响你和友军的光环技能，提高光环对友军的效果，但使其无法作用于你。无法辅助诅咒类光环，或其他只影响敌人的光环。无法辅助图腾所施放的技能。不能调整召唤生物技能。

English: Supports aura skills that create permanent auras around you, changing their reservation to a cost and making them temporary. Cannot support banner or stance skills.
简体中文: 辅助在你周围产生永久性效果的光环技能，将它们的保留效果变为具有消耗的暂时性效果，不能辅助旗帜技能和姿态技能。

English: Supports aura skills that reserve life or mana to create auras around you.
简体中文: 辅助保留生命或魔力并在你周围产生光环的技能。

English: Supports banner skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助旗帜技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.
简体中文: 辅助将箭矢像投射物一般向前发射的弓箭攻击技能。被辅助技能改为朝空中射出一支负载箭矢，落到目标地点。然后向外射出一圈箭矢。不能辅助原本就朝空中射击的技能、吟唱技能或召唤生物技能。

English: Supports bow attack skills, causing them to trigger when you've spent enough mana in total on other bow attacks. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Cannot support totems, traps, mines, Vaal skills, or channelling skills
简体中文: 辅助弓箭攻击技能，当你在其他弓箭攻击上花费足够魔力时触发它们。无法影响召唤生物的技能。不能辅助图腾、陷阱、地雷、瓦尔技能或吟唱技能

English: Supports bow attack skills. Cannot support channelled skills, instant skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助弓类攻击技能。无法辅助引导技能、瞬发技能、瓦尔技能，或由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports brand skills that can be recalled.
简体中文: 辅助可被召回的烙印技能。

English: Supports channelling spells you cast yourself, significantly empowering their damage the longer they are channelled for, while also raising their cost. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助你自己施放的持续吟唱法术，随着施法时间的提高大幅增强被辅助技能的伤害与消耗。无法修改召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports hex curse skills, causing them to trigger Doom Blast when the hex ends. Cannot support curse skills which are triggered or applied as an aura.
简体中文: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，使魔蛊在结束时触发【末日爆炸】。不能辅助触发型和光环类诅咒技能。

English: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.
简体中文: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，将其变为光环，并将它的效果施加给你周围的所有敌人。

English: Supports hex curse skills. Hexes from auras or cursed ground cannot transfer.
简体中文: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，光环或诅咒区域的魔蛊无法被转移。

English: Supports melee attack skills that are not triggered.
简体中文: 辅助并非被触发施放的近战攻击技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills which can be exerted. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Vaal skills and channelling skills cannot be exerted.
简体中文: 辅助可以被增助的近战攻击技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。瓦尔技能和持续吟唱技能无法被增助。

English: Supports melee attack skills without a cooldown. Those skills will be used by Mirage Warriors summoned by General's Cry. Supported skills cannot be supported by Multistrike.
简体中文: 辅助没有冷却时间的近战攻击技能。这些技能由将军战吼召唤的幻影武士使用。被辅助技能无法被多重打击辅助。

English: Supports melee attack skills you use yourself. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助你亲自施放的近战攻击技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills, causing them to deal more damage against bleeding enemies, but preventing those skills from inflicting bleeding on enemies in any way.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能对流血敌人造成更多伤害，但该技能无法再使敌人流血。

English: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能在使用时自动重复三次，每次以一个随机的敌人为目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、旅行技能、反击技能或触发类技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat twice when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能在使用时自动重复两次，每次以一个随机的敌人为目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、旅行技能、反击技能或触发类技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能，无法辅助触发攻击技能、除你之外的生物使用的攻击技能，或能够召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee attack skills. Minions cannot gain rage.
简体中文: 辅助近战攻击技能。召唤生物无法获得怒火。

English: Supports melee attacks you use yourself. Does not modify skills used by minions.
简体中文: 辅助你亲自使用的近战攻击。无法影响召唤生物使用的技能。

English: Supports melee attacks. Does not modify skills used by minions.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能，无法影响召唤生物使用的技能。

English: Supports melee strike or slam skills. Every third time you use a supported attack, that use of the skill will be more powerful.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能和猛击技能。被辅助技能每次施展第三次的时候都会施放强力一击.

English: Supports melee strike skills that do not inherently apply Trauma. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助本身不会施加内伤的近战打击技能。不能辅助触发类技能、瓦尔技能或除你之外的生物使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports melee strike skills, causing their melee strike to deal splash damage around each target hit.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能，在每个击中的目标周围造成溅射伤害。

English: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助近战打击技能，使该技能可以同时打击额外的目标，额外目标和使用者之间必须保持最小距离。如果用来辅助召唤生物的攻击技能，则该召唤生物不会获得额外打击目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能或触发技能。
辅助非光环魔蛊诅咒技能。

English: Supports offering skills you use yourself.
简体中文: 辅助由你亲自施放的奉献技能。

English: Supports projectile attack skills that use bows or wands. Cannot support triggered skills, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.
简体中文: 辅助使用弓类或法杖的投射物攻击技能。不能辅助触发技能、吟唱技能或召唤生物技能。

English: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.
简体中文: 辅助投射物和其他任意能连锁的技能。

English: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first time they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.
简体中文: 辅助投射物技能，使该技能的投射物在首次击中敌人时不再穿透并分叉成 2 个。

English: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.
简体中文: 辅助投射物技能，使它们的投射物在头两次击中敌人且未穿透时，分裂为两个。

English: Supports projectile spells you cast yourself. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, instant skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation or which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.
简体中文: 辅助你自身施放的投射物法术。无法辅助触发类技能、瓦尔技能、瞬发技能、持续吟唱技能，有保留效果或产生召唤生物技能，以及图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。

English: Supports ranged attack skills that fire projectiles upwards. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.
简体中文: 辅助向上发射投射物的远程攻击技能。无法辅助触发类攻击、非你亲自使用的攻击，或创造召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports skills that can hit enemies, or create minions. When those skills or minions kill enemies, or hit rare or unique enemies they will have a chance to summon a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.
简体中文: 辅助可以击中敌人或召唤生物的技能。当该技能或召唤生物击败敌人，或击中稀有或传奇敌人时，有一定几率召唤一个幻灵，该生物可以使用穿刺投射物法术造成物理伤害。

English: Supports skills that create minions which can be damaged. Cannot support triggered skills.
简体中文: 辅助可创造可被伤害的召唤生物的技能。无法辅助触发类技能。

English: Supports skills that create sentinel minions, causing those minions to be created with a beneficial templar aura.
简体中文: 辅助可创造哨兵召唤生物的技能，使这些召唤物被创造时获得圣堂光环增益效果。

English: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.
简体中文: 辅助玩家自身射出投射物的技能。不会影响其他来源或二次产生的投射物。无法辅助螺旋发射投射物的技能。

English: Supports skills that have a cooldown. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助有冷却时间的技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have resonance of all three elements, and to grant resonance of elements other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 Resonance for each Element. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助击中敌人的技能，使其在你具有所有三种元素共振时获得加成，击中时除了造成最高伤害的那一个之外，给予其它元素的共振效果。每种元素的共振效果最多 50 层。不能辅助触发技能、瞬发技能、法球技能、烙印技能、有保留效果的技能，或图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have unholy resonance of lightning, physical and chaos, and to grant unholy resonance of damage types other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 unholy resonance for each damage type. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。当你拥有闪电、物理与混沌的罪恶共鸣时，使技能获得加成；并且在一次击中，如果某伤害类型的数值并非最高，则其每次击中会为你提供该伤害类型的罪恶共鸣。每种伤害类型的罪恶共鸣最多 50 层。无法辅助触发类技能、瞬发技能、法球技能、烙印技能、带保留效果的技能，或由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports skills that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助能击中敌人的技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports skills that summon ballista totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助召唤弩炮图腾的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
辅助创造召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports skills which summon totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助召唤图腾的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports skills which throw Traps or Mines.

简体中文: 辅助有冷却时间的技能。

English: Supports slam skills you use yourself, causing them to create fissures when impacting the ground.
简体中文: 辅助你亲自施放的猛击技能，使其在击中地面时创造出裂隙。

English: Supports slam skills, causing them to summon an ancestor totem that uses the skill for you while you're near it. Being near it grants you increased area of effect for melee skills.
简体中文: 辅助猛击技能，使其召唤出一个先祖图腾，在你靠近图腾的时候为你使用技能。靠近图腾还可以为你提高近战技能的效果区域。

English: Supports slam skills, providing a powerful boost when they're used, with a delay before they can be boosted again. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Only skills you use yourself can receive the boost.

English: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助对目标位置造成范围效果的法术技能。无法辅助瓦尔技能、图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports spell skills that are instant and have no reservation. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助瞬发且没有保留效果的法术技能。无法辅助瓦尔技能，或由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。

English: Supports spell skills that have no reservation. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

English: Supports spell skills that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
简体中文: 辅助击中敌人的法术技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。

简体中文: 辅助法术技能，使其施放时重复一次。无法辅助瓦尔技能、图腾技能、烙印技能、持续吟唱技能、触发技能、瞬发技能、反击技能、闪现技能或有保留效果的技能。

简体中文: 挥舞斧类或剑类并发射投射物，在撞击或发射后不久粉碎，对前方敌人造成范围伤害。

简体中文: 用双手锤或长杖画圈挥舞，召唤神圣之锤随机落在被击中的数个敌人身上。这些神圣之锤造成的击中无法被闪避。

简体中文: 对一个灵柩施法，使其周围目标都受到一个法术伤害。同时使该灵柩爆炸， 对附近的敌人造成火焰伤害。爆炸造成的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。

English: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. 简体中文: 对一个灵柩施法，使其周围目标都受到一个法术伤害。同时使该灵柩爆炸，对附近的敌人造成火焰伤害。爆炸造成的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。爆炸会继续指定区域内的其他灵柩，每个灵柩之间的爆炸间隔较短，直到灵柩消耗殆尽或有 8 个灵柩被引爆。无法被多重范围施法辅助。

English: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. English: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
简体中文: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，羁绊对象可以触发你辅助的法术。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。

English: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they get recovery from your life leech instead of you. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
简体中文: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，你的生命偷取改为给羁绊对象恢复生命。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。

English: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

（将物理伤害的 100% 转化为混沌伤害）
（击中时有 25% 的几率施加凋零）

English: This will enable the Unholy Might buff.

This will enable the Unholy Might buff.
(Grants 100% of Physical Damage converted to Chaos Damage)
(25% chance to apply Wither on Hit)
简体中文:
启用不洁之力增益。
（将物理伤害的 100% 转化为混沌伤害）
（击中时有 25% 的几率施加凋零）

English: This will override the number of Mines per throw
简体中文: 覆盖每次投掷的地雷数量

English: This will override the number of Traps per throw
简体中文: 覆盖每次投掷的陷阱数量

English: Throw up to 1 additional Trap if dual wielding
简体中文: 双持时最多额外投掷 1 个陷阱

English: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area and has a chance to poison. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
简体中文: 投掷一个爆炸瓶，在一片区域内造成徒手攻击伤害，并有几率使敌人中毒。可以消耗生命药剂的充能来进一步增加伤害。需要空出主手，且没有持握副手武器。

English: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
简体中文: 投掷一个爆炸瓶，在一片区域内造成徒手攻击伤害。可以消耗红玉药剂、黄玉药剂、蓝玉药剂的充能来进一步增加伤害。需要空出主手，也不能持握副手武器。

English: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.
简体中文: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时对一片区域造成伤害，然后发射火焰投射物，在其周围像雨点一样散落，每颗投射物都会小范围的爆炸。放置在地上的地雷，会对其范围内的敌人施加火焰曝露效果。

English: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.
简体中文: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时对一片区域造成伤害。

English: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
简体中文: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时向周围发射投射物，在飞行途中快速挥发，并很快消失。

English: Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
简体中文: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时向敌人发射投射物，在飞行途中快速消散，并很快消失。

English: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
简体中文: 投掷一个地雷，当它引爆时将你传送至该地雷所在处。当传送时，在原本位置与地雷所在位置的区块都会被充满烟雾，致盲其中的敌人，并给你一个提高移动速度的临时增益效果。和其它闪现技能共用冷却时间。

English: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
简体中文: 投掷一个爆炸瓶，击中地面时爆发，在一片区域内造成徒手攻击伤害，并有几率使敌人中毒。该技能可以连锁，多次随机弹跳并造成伤害。可以消耗生命药剂的充能来进一步增加伤害。需要空出主手，且没有持握副手武器。

English: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.
简体中文: 复制手中的近战武器，并将此灵体投掷出去。此灵体将会向外飞出并如同回力镖一般回到你的身边，对所有碰触到的敌人造成伤害。

English: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls.
简体中文: 复制一把手中的近战武器并投掷出去。它会盘旋飞出，形成一个巨大的螺旋，对路径上所有敌人造成伤害。如果碰到墙壁会回弹。

English: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.
简体中文: 使用念能力复制副手上的盾并且掷出穿刺投射物，造成盾牌防御属性强化的副手伤害。抵达目标位置时悬停在原地，向各个方向重复发射一定数量的小型碎片投射物。碎片发射速度不断加快，直到碎片发射完毕。影响投射物数量的词缀碎会增加碎片的数量，但不会增加投掷盾的数量。

English: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.
简体中文: 使用念能力复制副手上的盾并且掷出制造出根据盾防御属性的副手伤害。该投射物无法穿透敌人，当击中敌人时，该投射物会碎裂，制造出射向各方的小的碎片投射物。影响投射物数量的词缀会增加碎片的数量，但不会增加投掷盾的数量。

English: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the evasion of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.
简体中文: 使用念能力复制副手上的盾并且掷出，根据盾的闪避值属性造成副手伤害。该投射物无法穿透敌人，当击中敌人时，该投射物会碎裂，制造出射向各方的小的碎片投射物。影响投射物数量的词缀会增加碎片的数量，但不会增加投掷盾的数量。

English: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，在一定时间内对周围一定数量的敌人发射带有减益效果的光线。光线会冰缓敌人，并造成持续性冰霜伤害。

English: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，在一定时间内对周围一定数量的敌人发射带有减益效果的光线。光线会冰缓敌人，并造成持续性冰霜伤害。光线也会基于被其射中的敌人数量，来使你获得一定额度的生命和魔力再生。

English: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，触发后造成一场大爆炸，在周围区域内造成法术伤害。

English: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.
简体中文: 抛出一个触发时在其周围制造一圈冰霜印记爆破的陷阱，对所有在爆破范围内的敌人造成冰霜伤害。

English: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.
简体中文: 抛出一个触发时会制造一连串冰霜印记爆破的陷阱, 对所有在爆破范围内的敌人造成冰霜伤害.

English: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，触发后造成一场爆炸，在周围区域内造成法术伤害。第一次爆炸后陷阱周围的次级区域内会连续快速产生多次小爆炸。

English: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，对单个敌人造成伤害并使其定身，定身时长由造成的伤害决定。定身结束后，敌人将承受一个移动速度降低的减益效果。被该减益影响的敌人承受陷阱和地雷的伤害会提高。法术伤害加成不会影响该技能。

English: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，对单个敌人造成伤害、穿刺与定身，定身时长由造成的伤害决定。法术伤害加成不会影响该技能。

English: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱, 该陷阱被触发时会爆炸并对周围的敌人造成火焰伤害, 且该区域的地面会持续燃烧, 踩在上面的敌人会持续受到伤害.

English: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，该陷阱被触发时会爆炸并对周围的敌人造成火焰伤害。

English: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets and leaving a trail of shocked ground.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，该陷阱被敌人触发时向四面环状发射投射物，对该敌人和后续接触到的敌人造成闪电伤害，并同时留下感电地面。

English: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱, 该陷阱被触发时将会向全方位散射出闪电投射物, 投射物将会对触发及接触到的敌人造成闪电伤害.

English: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，该陷阱被触发时将会散射出闪电投射物，投射物将会对触发及接触到的敌人造成闪电伤害。

English: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，触发后向不同方向喷射烈焰。烈焰将持续一段时间，并重复造成伤害。

English: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，触发后向不同方向喷射烈焰。烈焰持续一段时间，会在陷阱周围旋转，并重复造成伤害。对燃烧的敌人造成更多伤害。

English: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱, 触发该陷阱的敌人将会短暂的转化为你的手下为你而战.

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时发射一个近战武器的灵幻副本。它会盘旋飞出，形成一个巨大的螺旋，对路径上所有敌人造成伤害。如果碰到墙壁会回弹。双持时每个投掷的陷阱会随机使用主手或副手武器。

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires many spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out in all directions and then return to where the trap triggered, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时发射多个近战武器的灵幻副本。它们向四面八方飞出后返回陷阱触发点，以回旋形式攻击并对沿途路径上的敌人造成伤害。双持时每个投掷的陷阱会随机使用主手或副手武器。

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, releases a number of waves. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，触发后发射多股冲击波。每股冲击波都会在其行进线路上产生连续的小冲击，最后以一次大冲击结束。

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, repeatedly releases a number of waves for a duration. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，触发后会在一定时间内持续发射冲击波。每股冲击波都会在其行进线路上产生连续的小冲击，最后以一次大冲击结束。

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw or One Handed Sword around it in circles, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时旋转挥舞你装备的两把匕首、爪类或单手剑的副本，反复不断对它范围内的敌人造成伤害。

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw, One Handed Sword or One Handed Axe around it in a circle, each damaging enemies it spins through.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时旋转挥舞你装备的两把匕首、爪类、单手剑或单手斧的副本，对它范围内的敌人造成伤害。

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时旋转挥舞你装备的两把双手剑的副本，反复不断对它范围内的敌人造成伤害，持续一定时间。

English: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
简体中文: 投掷陷阱，触发后会在一定时间内连续电击多个区域，并造成闪电伤害。

English: Throws an intangible spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then becomes tangible as it returns to you, in a spinning attack that only hits and damages enemies while returning.
简体中文: 复制手中的近战武器，并将此无形灵体投掷出去。此灵体将会向外飞出，并在归返时化为实体，仅能在返回时击中敌人并造成伤害。

English: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.
简体中文: 向你的前方投掷连锁钩爪，附着在命中的目标上。被束缚的敌人受到攻击时为施法者提供怒火。当锁链断裂时，会在束缚目标周围区域造成攻击伤害。限定单手锤、短杖、剑类或斧类。

English: Throws out a trap which creates a rift, attracting a malefic hand from another realm. When the trap is triggered, the hand tears the bottom of the breach out, shattering reality to deal spell damage in an area.
简体中文: 投掷一个陷阱, 该陷阱会创造一个裂隙，并从异界吸引来一只恶魔之手。当陷阱被触发时，这只手会撕裂裂隙的底部，粉碎现实，在一个区域内造成法术伤害。

English: Throws several spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out and then return to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path.
简体中文: 复制数把手中的近战武器，把它们投掷出去。它们飞出后会以回旋形式返回，伤害沿途路径上的敌人。

English: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it.
简体中文: 向前投掷一把剑或斧头，在前方凝聚一团剑刃。它会依次对前方或靠近它的敌人发射投射物。

English: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward, consuming your Steel Shards to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
简体中文: 向前投掷一把剑或斧头，消耗钢刃碎片在前方凝聚一团剑刃。它会依次对前方或靠近它的敌人发射投射物。钢刃碎片由【钢铁呼唤】提供。
获得最大封印所需时间

English: Tincture Effects Linger on you for 0.5 seconds per Mana Burn on you when the Tincture was deactivated, up to a maximum of 6 seconds
简体中文: 酊剂失效后，每层魔力燃烧使其效果在你身上持续 0.5 秒，最多 6 秒

English: Tincture Effects also apply to Ranged Weapons
简体中文: 酊剂效果也能对远程武器生效

English: Tinctures applied to you have 10% increased Effect
简体中文: 对你生效的酊剂效果提高 10%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 10% reduced Mana Burn rate
简体中文: 对你生效的酊剂的魔力燃烧速度减慢 10%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 15% increased Effect
简体中文: 对你生效的酊剂效果提高 15%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 15% increased Effect if you've used a Life Flask Recently
简体中文: 若你近期使用过生命药剂，对你生效的酊剂效果提高 15%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 30% less Mana Burn rate
简体中文: 对你生效的酊剂的魔力燃烧速度总降 30%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 5% increased Effect
简体中文: 对你生效的酊剂效果提高 5%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 5% reduced Mana Burn rate
简体中文: 对你生效的酊剂的魔力燃烧速度减慢 5%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 75% increased Effect per empty Flask Slot
简体中文: 每个空的药水栏位使对你生效的酊剂效果提高 75%

English: Tinctures applied to you have 8% increased Effect
简体中文: 对你生效的酊剂效果提高 8%

English: Tinctures deactivate when you have 12 or more Mana Burn
简体中文: 拥有 12 层及以上的魔力燃烧时取消酊剂效果

English: Tinctures have 40% increased effect while at or above 10 stacks of Mana Burn
简体中文: 叠加至少 10 层魔力燃烧时，酊剂的效果提高 40%

English:
Tinctures inflict Weeping Wounds instead of Mana Burn
Effects that interact with Mana Burn interact with Weeping Wounds instead
简体中文:
酊剂造成泣血创伤，而非魔力燃烧
与魔力燃烧互动的效果改为对泣血创伤生效

简体中文: 提示：按住 Ctrl 隐藏提示。

简体中文: 提示：按住 Shift 或 Ctrl 隐藏提示。

简体中文: 提示：按住 Shift 查看所提供技能的详细说明

简体中文: 提示：按 Ctrl+C 复制此天赋的文本。

简体中文: 提示：在物品页按 Ctrl+D 隐藏属性差异。

简体中文: 提示：在物品页按 Ctrl+D 显示属性差异。

简体中文: 提示：按 Ctrl+D 隐藏属性差异。

简体中文: 提示：按 Ctrl+D 显示属性差异。

简体中文: 提示：右键点击此插槽，前往物品页选择要放入的珠宝。

简体中文: 提示：右键点击，编辑此节点的符文嵌板。

简体中文: 提示：右键点击，编辑此节点的纹身。

简体中文: 提示：若要沿其他路径连接到此节点，请按住 Shift，沿目标路径移动鼠标，再点击此节点
